authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9502 *bhiyajyate gets wet explicitly gives Assamese bhiziba, Bengali bhijā, Oriya bhijibā, Maithili bhijlāh wet and Bhojpuri bhījal. The survey bij/bhij/bhiz series and l-participial forms match those comparanda. Affricate/retroflex-affricate notation, aspiration, final vowels and local transmission remain qualified; no extra light verb is silently discarded. Exact response: bi̤jlʰa.
